Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::deleteProductCatalog(id: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentStore.Productcatalogs->exists(catalog: ProductCatalog|catalog.Id = id)
	postcondition:
		let deletedCatalog: ProductCatalog = self.CurrentStore.Productcatalogs@pre->any(catalog: ProductCatalog|catalog.Id = id) in
		self.CurrentStore.Productcatalogs@pre->includes(deletedCatalog) and
		self.CurrentStore.Productcatalogs->excludes(deletedCatalog) and
		result = true
}
